text:
Maria: FYI depot triage report — thermal sensor failures on 12 H100 units from the EU shipment that landed yesterday.
Jordan: Ugh. Which depot? photos?
Maria: FRA2. Photos + sensor logs uploaded to the thread. AWB: 763-9901234. Sample log:
```
TEMP_OK: false
sensor_id: S-4123
max_temp: 98C
```
Maria: Opening RMA and triage. Do we want replacements shipped from NL pool or ask vendor for depot repair?
vendor-zenith: Sorry about that, we can prioritize replacements from NL but need confirmation on customs paperwork (EU->EU). ETA for 12 units via air: 3 days if we get go-ahead now.
vendor-zenith: Can also schedule depot repair, 5-7 business days, but that's subject to spare board availability.
Kevin: Costwise, air replacements = +€3.2k/unit expedite fee. What fraction can we absorb vs vendor credit?
vendor-zenith: We can credit 75% of expedite fee for DOA in first 30 days. After that, 50%.
Maria: These are part of a recent top-off; still within 21 days.
Ashley: Cluster impact note — we'll lose ~24 TFLOPS for the next 48h if we pull from pool. Can we failover jobs to us-west burst? Some jobs are latency insensitive.
Jordan: Operational plan: split the 12 units — 8 expedited replacements, 4 depot repairs. Keeps capacity up.
Kevin: Okay run numbers. If we do 8 air repls: expedite cost = 8 * €3.2k = €25.6k gross. Vendor credit 75% => net ~€6.4k to us. Approve?
Maria: Approve provisional split. Please create shipment manifest and AWB list.
Jordan: Draft manifest uploaded. Shipping idx:
```
1: AWB 763-9902345 -> NL depot (8 units)
2: AWB 763-9903456 -> FRA2 (4 units return/repair)
```
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-2026-1387 for 12 units. Case link: https://rma.redwood/RMA-2026-1387
Maria: @vendor-zenith please confirm pickup window and provide courier details for AWB 763-9902345.
vendor-zenith: Pickup scheduled today 18:30 CET, carrier: AirBlue. Tracking: https://track.airblue/7639902345
Jordan: Note customs doc: use CN23 + commercial invoice flagged as "replacement under warranty" to avoid duties.
Kevin: Also flag for insurance claim: file# IC-7642. If any units arrive DOA on receive, take photos + serials.
Ashley: For postmortem: add sensor firmware versions and thermal ramp tests to eval deck. We should remove affected batch from auto-deploy until QC passes.
Maria: Will tag 12 serials with "TEMP_FAIL_2026-03" in inventory and remove from scheduler pool.
Jordan: FYI logistics will require a short-term loaner if any critical nodes go down; @Kevin — can procurement release 2 loaner H100s from hot pool?
Kevin: Yes, 2 loaners reserved. Cost center charge to infra-provision.
vendor-zenith: Will also send an engineering rep to depot if repairs exceed 5 units.
Maria: Thanks — I'll update the incident doc. :thumbsup:
Ashley: Adding a quick alert to observability for thermal spikes on that shipment's serials.
Maria: Closing loop here once AWB scan and RMA acceptance confirmed.
vendor-zenith: Confirmed pickup scanned 18:37 CET. Will update when in transit. :truck:
Maria: copied. thanks everyone.
